outcome.answer:
Several papers propose inference-time decoding strategies for multimodal models. For diffusion-based multimodal LLMs, Information-Guided Frontier Decoding commits useful semantic anchors ahead of fragile structural tokens [1], while Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Decoding selects positions with complementary visual grounding [2]. Context-Aware Cluster Decoding prioritizes tokens supported by decoded neighbors [3].

Other approaches target distinct goals: causal decoding reduces object hallucinations through interventions during generation [4], and LIME shifts relevance toward perceptual input tokens to improve grounding and reduce hallucinations [9]. A survey reviews decoding methods for large language and vision-language models across token-level, sequence-level, and parallel-generation paradigms [5].
